name: Pressure
desc: force + grip. Outward: force and grip deal the strike’s damage. Inward: Braced, +1 armor per point of Pressure x Inward. Also the denominator of Inward, so more pressure means a smaller inward share.

name: Momentum
desc: mass x speed. Outward: bludgeoning strike power and a 9% concussion chance per point. Inward: Kinetic Haste, faster actions. Its square root also lowers Acuity.

name: Inertia
desc: mass minus speed, floored at 0. Outward at 3 or more: Kinetic Bulwark, which blocks all ranged attacks except light. Inward at 2 or more: Rooted, blunt resistance, and Dazed and Concussed land at half intensity.

name: Acuity
desc: clairvoyance / (reach + square root of momentum). At 2 or more the strike is piercing and cannot miss; it ignores 9% of armor per point, x (1 + Coherence). Outward: Read, lowers the target’s dodge and parry. Inward: Foresight, attacks against you have a 3% chance to miss per point of Acuity x Inward. Momentum lowers it, so a spell has high Acuity or high Momentum, not both.

name: Awareness
desc: clairvoyance x reach. Outward: adds 0.5 x √Awareness to spread (see Reach), so the spell splashes and then hits every enemy, afflictions included. Inward: Wide Sight, physical resistances.

name: Coherence
desc: space / (force + mass). Withholds up to 40% of the strike’s damage and multiplies armor penetration by (1 + Coherence). Outward at 1 or more: Compressed, the target loses speed. Inward: sets how long every inward effect lasts, 20 seconds x (1 + Coherence).

name: Purchase
desc: grip / (1 + speed). Sets how long afflictions stay on the target: 10 seconds + 4 seconds per point, about 50 seconds at grip 10 with no speed. At 0 every effect still applies, for 10 seconds.

name: Inward
desc: vitality / (vitality + pressure). The share of every quantity applied to you rather than the target; the rest goes outward. Momentum outward is a strike, inward is action speed. Nothing is discarded.
